claim_boundary: The analysis establishes reproducible chemical-domain dependence of the Vina-derived target network on the tested supports. It does not identify a causal descriptor, validate pose correctness, establish biological truth, or demonstrate improved per-ligand target retrieval.

DOCKSTRING-58.group_definition: RDKit Bemis-Murcko scaffolds; every acyclic molecule is a singleton
DOCKSTRING-58.support_rule: sorted simple random sample without replacement of 15,000 complete ligands; NumPy seed 71

descriptor_decomposition_metrics.descriptor_removal_interpretation: Removing the group-held-out, fold-locally predicted descriptor component reduces mean squared target correlation; this is a predictive decomposition of score structure, not a causal attribution
descriptor_decomposition_metrics.pc1_definition_scope: PC1 loadings are descriptive loadings of the pooled out-of-fold surface; every ligand-level descriptor prediction is group-held-out

fixed_endpoint.panel_transform: non-raw surfaces are row-centered again after restriction to the fixed 20-target panel, matching the panel-restricted residual estimand
fixed_endpoint.selection_independence: not used to choose MW, bin edges, transformations, or target-pair threshold

group_bootstrap.DOCKSTRING-58_unit: RDKit Bemis-Murcko scaffolds; every acyclic molecule is a singleton
group_bootstrap.scheme: paired nonparametric cluster bootstrap; sample the union of groups in both MW domains with replacement and apply each group multiplicity to all of its rows in both domains

mw_stratified_group_disjoint_control.DOCKSTRING-58_unit: RDKit Bemis-Murcko scaffolds; every acyclic molecule is a singleton
mw_stratified_group_disjoint_control.purpose: distinguish MW-domain drift from generic chemically disjoint library composition under closely matched MW distributions
mw_stratified_group_disjoint_control.scheme: assign every frozen chemical group wholly to one of two halves; assignment occurs within deciles of group-median MW and greedily balances ligand-row counts

primary_stratifier_selection: selected after preliminary inspection; not prospectively prespecified
random_null: two simple-random, nonoverlapping supports matching the observed low/high observed low/high MW threshold-group row counts; finite-support calibration, not a chemical-group null

transformations.group_heldout_descriptor_adjusted_residu: five-fold group-held-out residual score error after fold-local target offsets/scales, descriptor scaling, and seven-descriptor linear fit
transformations.row_centered_residual: within-ligand target mean removed; target correlation then removes column offsets, making this correlation-equivalent to two-way centering

within_mw_band_reproducibility_control.DOCKSTRING-58_unit: RDKit Bemis-Murcko scaffolds; every acyclic molecule is a singleton
within_mw_band_reproducibility_control.interval_interpretation: central 95% repeated-split composition-sensitivity range; not a population confidence interval
within_mw_band_reproducibility_control.purpose: distinguish genuine low-versus-high map drift from instability induced by estimating target correlations on an MW-restricted support
within_mw_band_reproducibility_control.scheme: split the low- and high-MW threshold groups independently; compare equal-size row-random disjoint halves and whole-chemical-group halves assigned within deciles of within-band group-median MW
